product_overview: KATCHO is a real-time multiplayer social deduction and memory party game that runs in the browser as a PWA. Players join a room, lock in secret words, watch a flash sequence, and then use turn-based accusations and votes to finish the match.
core_goals: Create or join a game room quickly from a browser
Enter and lock secret words for the match
Watch the word flash sequence and prepare deductions
Accuse players, pass turns, or call a draw during guessing
View the final reveal table and start another round
Use the app as an installable PWA with optional local network sharing

features.name: Landing Entry Screen
features.description: Players start the game by entering a display name and choosing whether to create a new room or join an existing one.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Enter display name -> Create a new room -> See the game room open with a room code
Navigate to / -> Enter display name -> Enter a 4-letter room code -> Join the room -> See the game room open
Navigate to / -> Enter display name -> Press Enter in the name field -> See a room created or joined based on the current state
Navigate to / -> Enter display name -> Open the LAN sharing prompt -> See hotspot and QR join information
Navigate to / -> Open the install prompt -> See the app install guidance

features.name: Room Creation and WebSocket Connection
features.description: Hosts create a room and connect to the live multiplayer game session.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Enter display name -> Create a new room -> See the room code badge appear -> See connection status become online

features.name: Room Joining
features.description: Guests join an existing room by entering the room code and connecting to the live session.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Enter display name -> Enter a 4-letter room code -> Join the room -> See the game view and player roster
Navigate to / -> Enter display name -> Press Enter in the room code field -> Join the room -> See the game view and player roster

features.name: Secret Word Submission
features.description: During the lobby phase, players enter secret word(s) and lock them in before the round begins.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Enter display name -> Join or host a room -> Enter a secret word -> Lock the word -> See confirmation that the word is locked
Navigate to / -> Enter display name -> Join or host a room -> Enter a locked word -> Choose to change it -> Edit the word -> Lock it again -> See the updated locked confirmation
Navigate to / -> Join an active lobby -> Enter secret word(s) -> Lock each word -> See the ready count update

features.name: Word Mode Selection
features.description: The host chooses whether each player uses one word or two words when the room has fewer than seven players.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Enter display name -> Host a room -> Open the word mode selector -> Choose 1 word per player -> See the mode label update
Navigate to / -> Enter display name -> Host a room -> Open the word mode selector -> Choose 2 words per player -> See the mode label update

features.name: Visual Moderator Word Flash
features.description: The game shows a timed flash sequence of submitted words and locks the scratchpad while the reveal is running.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Join an active room -> Start the reveal phase -> See a countdown begin -> See words flash one by one with animation -> See the progress update -> See the scratchpad lock -> See the deduce prompt appear when the sequence ends

features.name: Turn-Based Accusation
features.description: In the guessing phase, the active player chooses a target, makes an accusation, passes the turn, or calls for a draw.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Join a room in the guessing phase -> See that it is your turn -> Select a target player -> Enter a suspected word -> Accuse the target -> See the accusation result announcement
Navigate to / -> Join a room in the guessing phase -> See that it is your turn -> Pass the turn -> See the turn move to another player
Navigate to / -> Join a room in the guessing phase -> See that it is your turn -> Call a draw -> See the draw vote process begin

features.name: Truth-Locked Verification Modal
features.description: An accused player responds to a guess with a single verified truth action.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Receive an accusation modal -> See the guessed word and guesser name -> Confirm the verified result -> Broadcast the truth-locked answer
Navigate to / -> Receive an accusation modal -> See the guessed word and guesser name -> Confirm the verified result as correct -> Broadcast the YES response
Navigate to / -> Receive an accusation modal -> See the guessed word and guesser name -> Confirm the verified result as incorrect -> Broadcast the NO response

features.name: Draw Vote Modal
features.description: All players vote to agree or disagree with ending the match in a draw.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> A draw vote starts -> See the draw vote modal and current tally -> Agree to the draw -> See your vote counted
Navigate to / -> A draw vote starts -> See the draw vote modal and current tally -> Disagree with the draw -> See your vote counted

features.name: Game Over and Reveal Table
features.description: At the end of a match, players see the winner or draw result and a full reveal of all secret words and scores.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Reach game over -> See the winner announcement or draw result -> Review the reveal table -> See all players, secret words, status, and scores
Navigate to / -> Reach game over -> See the winner announcement or draw result -> Start another round -> See a new match begin with the same players

features.name: Private Scratchpad
features.description: Players can keep local notes for suspects, deductions, and remembered words.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Type notes in the scratchpad -> See notes save automatically
Navigate to / -> Type notes in the scratchpad -> Clear the notes -> See the scratchpad become empty
Navigate to / -> Reach the word flash phase -> See the scratchpad lock -> Reach the guessing phase -> See the scratchpad unlock

features.name: LAN / Hotspot QR Code Modal
features.description: Players can share the room on a local network using a QR code and direct LAN URL.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the LAN sharing modal -> See the QR code and LAN URL -> Copy the URL -> Dismiss the modal
Navigate to / -> Open the LAN sharing modal -> See the QR code and LAN URL -> Close the modal

features.name: Rules / How to Play Modal
features.description: Players can read the game rules and phase-by-phase flow before or during a match.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the rules modal -> Read the phase overview -> Close the modal
Navigate to / -> Open the rules modal -> Press Escape -> Dismiss the modal

features.name: Sound Toggle
features.description: Players can turn game audio effects on or off.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Toggle sound -> See the audio icon switch between sound on and mute

features.name: PWA Install / Download App Modal
features.description: Players can install KATCHO as a standalone app on supported devices.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the install modal -> Read the install instructions -> Start the app install prompt -> Complete installation
Navigate to / -> Open the install modal -> Dismiss the modal

routes.description: Main KATCHO game SPA - entry screen with create/join room
Returns LAN IP, QR code data URL, and hotspot info

PWA service worker for offline caching

features.name: Landing Entry Screen
features.description: Players see the KATCHO branding, enter their display name, and choose to create or join a room
user_interactions: Enter display name in the player name input field

Enter a 4-letter room code in the room code input
Click "Join Room" button to join an existing room
Press Enter in the name field to auto-create or auto-join
Press Enter in the room code field to join
Click "Show Hotspot QR Code & LAN IP" link to open LAN modal
Click "Play Online Instantly" choice card
Click "Download / Install App" choice card

features.description: Host creates a new room, WebSocket connects, and room code is displayed

user_interactions: Enter 4-letter room code
Click "Join Room" button
See game view appear with player roster

features.name: Secret Word Submission (Phase 1 Lobby)
features.description: Players enter and lock their secret word(s) during lobby phase

See locked word confirmation with chip display

See ready count badge update

user_interactions: Click "Change" button next to mode label

See modal close and mode label update

features.name: Visual Moderator Word Flash (Phase 2 Reveal)
